summary: Validated live MINDPULSE API contracts, persistence, responsive navigation, assessment execution, results, explainability, and history detail modal.
action_items: Consider surfacing a user-visible persistence warning when MongoDB history writes fail instead of silently returning success.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/assessments/analyze intentionally catches persistence exceptions and still returns 200; this is acceptable for demo resilience but can mislead users about saved history.
The workspace avatar is rendered as a button without behavior; it is not part of the requested workflow but should be a non-button or wired control if retained.
seed_data_creation: The live demo already contained assessment records; one additional deterministic test assessment was created by API/UI runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Live preview URL tested at mobile width 390x844. Drawer closes after each navigation selection, so reopen it before selecting the next route. All requested routes and core assessment flow passed.
rca of the issue: Initial navigation attempt failed because the test clicked a hidden sidebar link after the prior click had correctly closed the mobile drawer. Reopening the drawer per route resolved the test sequencing issue; no product defect reproduced.
